name: CSF cytology (proposed tiered schemes)
use: Detection of leptomeningeal malignancy, infection, inflammation.
not_use: Not a validated international system – proposed tiered schemes only.

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Process fresh (<1–2 h) or refrigerate; ≥3–5 mL (ideally ≥10 mL for malignancy).

categories.name: Negative for malignant cells
criteria: Lymphocytes, monocytes, ependymal/choroid cells, germinal matrix in neonates.

diagnoses.name: Negative
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Negative for malignant cells

diagnoses.name: Lymphocytic pleocytosis (viral/TB meningitis)
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignant cells. Lymphocytic pleocytosis.
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Negative for malignant cells

diagnoses.name: Neutrophilic pleocytosis (bacterial meningitis)
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignant cells. Neutrophilic pleocytosis.
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Negative for malignant cells

diagnoses.name: Cryptococcus
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignant cells. Cryptococcus neoformans identified.
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Negative for malignant cells

diagnoses.name: Atypical cells
diagnoses.comment: Repeat CSF and flow cytometry recommended.

diagnoses.name: Suspicious
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Suspicious for malignancy

categories.name: Positive for malignant cells
criteria: Metastatic carcinoma (breast, lung), melanoma, lymphoma/leukaemia, medulloblastoma, germ cell tumours.

diagnoses.name: Metastatic carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Positive for malignant cells – metastatic carcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Positive for malignant cells

diagnoses.name: Lymphoma/leukaemia involvement
diagnoses.comment: Flow cytometry; beware traumatic tap with peripheral blasts.
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Positive for malignant cells

diagnoses.name: Medulloblastoma/primary CNS tumour
diagnoses.final: Positive for malignant cells – consistent with [tumour].
diagnoses.comment: CSF seeding alters staging (e.g. medulloblastoma M1); post-operative samples ideally ≥10–14 days after surgery to avoid false positives.
diagnoses.cat: Suggested template category: Positive for malignant cells

extra.title: Status
items: Consensus/descriptive – no official international reporting system.

references: Proposed CSF reporting schemes exist in the literature (e.g. tiered schemes analogous to other systems); none adopted internationally (verify).
